selection: normal and both MVP rollback-eligible fault families; one local instance each
maximum_calls: 3 separate synthetic bootstrap calls, then at most 5 per live workflow
observations: 8 checkout probes, 20-second collection window, model-selected read Gateway tools
storage: isolated PostgreSQL registry, evidence, trace, report, queue, policy/approval and official checkpoints
authority: Stop at PENDING human approval. Never approve or execute recovery. Injector cleanup is evaluator infrastructure.
labels: scenario and target exist only in outer fault orchestrator/output; workflow receives opaque IDs, measured alert and UTC window
failure_policy: Keep failed model/schema/Gate/Policy outcomes and cleanup results; never retry uncertain model effects for a better score
interpretation: Integration rehearsal, not paired diagnosis-quality benchmark, production capacity or human efficiency measurement
